footnote_text: Vesting of performance share units ("PSUs") previously granted to the Reporting Person and earned in November 2025 and November 2026. || Each PSU represents a contingent right to receive 1 share of the Issuer's Common Stock upon vesting and settlement for no consideration.

Exempt transaction pursuant to Section 16b-3(e) - payment of exercise price or tax liability by delivering or withholding securities incident to the receipt, exercise or vesting of a security issued in accordance with Rule 16b-3. All of the shares reported as disposed of in this Form 4 were withheld by the Issuer in accordance with the agreement governing the PSUs to satisfy federal and state tax withholding obligations of the Reporting Person resulting from the vesting and settlement of PSUs.
